'''Chelah''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] that lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the private medic of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]]. When Drayen was poisoned by his enemies with a unknown substance, Chelah froze him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to stop the progression of the disease. By [[3643 BBY]], Chelah lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he unfroze Drayen and attempted to save him. However, the attempt failed, and Nok Drayen died in Chelah's laboratory. Drayen's daughter [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] then released the Selkath from her family's service.
